class.name: Node
class.brief_description: A node that can have a parent and child nodes.
class.description: Nodes form the scene tree. Override the callbacks to run script code when a node enters, leaves, or updates in the tree.

method.name: SetName
method.description: Sets the node name. If a sibling already uses the name, a number is added to make it unique.
method.param: The new name. An empty name uses the engine class name.

method.name: GetName
method.description: Gets the node name.

method.name: SetSerializable
method.description: Sets whether this node and its child nodes can be saved in a packed scene.
method.param: True to allow saving this branch of the scene.

method.name: GetSerializable
method.description: Checks whether this node can be saved in a packed scene.
method.returns: True if this node allows saving. A parent that blocks saving also blocks this node.

method.name: SetReady
method.description: Sets whether OnReady is pending. This does not call OnReady right away. A pending call runs the next time this node goes through the ready step.
method.param: True to request another ready call, or false to clear the pending call.

method.name: GetReady
method.description: Checks whether an OnReady call is still pending.
method.returns: True if the ready call is pending. This does not mean the node is already ready.

method.name: SetProcess
method.description: Turns OnProcess calls on or off. The ready step turns processing on.
method.param: True to receive frame updates, or false to stop them.

method.name: GetProcess
method.description: Checks whether frame updates are enabled for this node.
method.returns: True if processing is enabled. The node must also be in a scene tree to receive updates.

method.name: GetRoot
method.description: Follows the parent links to find the top node.
method.returns: The top node, or this node if it has no parent.

method.name: GetParent
method.description: Gets the direct parent of this node.
method.returns: The parent node, or null if this node has no parent.

method.name: FindChildByName
method.description: Finds a child by name. Searches each child and its child nodes in order. Does not check this node.
method.returns: The first matching node, or null if no node matches.

method.name: GetSceneTree
method.description: Gets the scene tree that contains this node.
method.returns: The scene tree, or null if this node is outside a tree.

method.name: GetNode
method.description: Gets this node, a descendant, or a node at an absolute path. Logs an error when no node matches. Attached C# scripts retain their managed type.
method.param: A child path, a path starting with /Root, or . for this node. Parent path segments are not supported.

method.name: GetNodeOrNull
method.description: Gets a node without reporting a missing path.
method.param: A child path, an absolute path, or . for this node.

method.name: AddNode
method.description: Adds a child node. Moves it from its old parent if needed. If this node is in a scene tree, the child enters the same tree. Moving between different scene trees is not supported.
method.param: The node to add. A null node, this node, or an ancestor is ignored.

method.name: MoveChild
method.description: Changes the order of a direct child. Does nothing if the node is not a child of this node.
method.param: The new position, starting at zero. Values outside the child list are moved to the nearest end.

method.name: QueueFree
method.description: Queues this node and its child nodes for deletion by the scene tree. If this node is outside a tree, it is deleted right away. Do not use the node after calling this method.

method.name: Reparent
method.description: Moves this node to a new parent. The new parent must be a valid node. Moving between different scene trees is not supported.
method.param: The new parent. It must not be this node or one of its child nodes.
True to keep the world transform when this node is a Node3D. Has no effect on a plain Node.

method.name: OnEnterTree
method.description: Called each time this node enters a scene tree, before its child nodes enter.

method.name: OnExitTree
method.description: Called when this node leaves a scene tree, after its child nodes leave.

method.name: OnReady
method.description: Called after this node and its child nodes enter the scene tree. Child nodes become ready first. Runs once unless SetReady requests another call.

method.name: OnProcess
method.description: Called each frame while this node is in a scene tree and processing is enabled.
method.param: The time since the last frame, in seconds.
